q: What are you strength and weakness?
a:
**Strength:**

I think that I’m very good at time management. I can plan my tasks carefully and finish everything on time. For example, I always create a schedule for my day and follow it closely. Thanks to my time management skills, I do not miss deadliness.

I’m a very tidy person in terms of time management, and time management makes me feel more productive and helps me complete all of my task effectively.

**Weakness:**

I have trouble doing many taks at the same time. When I have many tasks to handle, I feel stressed and anxious. It is too hard for me to concentrate on all of them at once. Because of this, I prefer to work on one task at a time. I know that being able to multitask is important, especially for today’s professionals. So, I’m trying to improve this skill to help me get used to handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously. By practicing in this way, I hope to improve my multitasking skills.
